cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a small empty Western playhouse sound-effects booth behind the stage — she tries the humble job behind a river-goddess play: gently rolling dry peas across a tilted rain drum to make a soft shower sound; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; an outdoor court for tennis or basketball — sitting on the ground; a space-station docking bay with a sleek shuttle on its pad and long light strips — lying on her front; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — standing; a quiet orbital apartment laundry alcove with rounded unlettered washer doors — after a day of ceremonial composure she patiently finds the matching sock by comparing two almost identical narrow stripe patterns; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — sitting on the ground; a walled garden with a lotus pond — lying on her front; her living room with a deep sofa — threads a needle held up to the light; a retro-futurist home of rounded chrome appliances and soft panels — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a hilltop lookout over a wide valley — dips a bubble wand with a little bottle of soap into its little bottle of soap
